notes.title: Lunar's Chosen - Episode 2 now live!
notes.content:
It's here! The first release of V0.1 for Episode 2!

As I've mentioned before, this isn't going to be a hugely story content heavy release (although there are 16 new story scenes), as a lot was changed between episode 1 and 2, which required me to make a lot of other content, such as new rooms, new minor scenes for those rooms, new systems etc. It was a lot of work.

That said, I'll drop a changelog below, as there is still a tonne of content to explore and find (some of it hidden). Of course, secret images are still a thing, but now there's going to be hidden scenes too. These aren't scenes you'll have to really go hunting for, but they will be scenes that won't be listed in hints.

So you get an idea of what has been changed/added, I've added a changelog below!

Get the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2697200/Lunars_Chosen__Episode_2/

notes.title: V0.26 Release!
notes.content:
V0.26 Release!

Well, this arrived far faster than I expect, the ending of Episode 1! This is a huge milestone for both the game and myself. When I first started creating Lunar's Chosen, I never thought it'd reach the size it did, both in terms of the amount of content and popularity. If you're wondering by the way, I checked the total amount of dialogue for Episode 1 while looking into translating the game, there's over 484k words of dialogue! That's just dialogue, not code or anything else, just purely the bits you read in the in game text box. That's an insane amount of words!

Anyway onto the update, this update includes the ending of Episode 1, as well as more story for each of the main characters. It has a whole new location, the movie theatre, where you can take each of the main characters on a date once you unlock it, resulting in 9 new repeatable scenes! Speaking of repeatable scenes, I also updated Claire's footjob animation to be an actual animation!

Unrelated to content, I've also added a new feature in that you can name your save files. Most players don't really use this, so it's off by default, but if you want it, it can be toggled on in the preferences menu. 

Finally, to address why this is V0.26 and not V1.0 despite being the ending of Episode 1, that's because V1.0 will come later to Itch and Steam. It won't contain any new content, but there's a few things I want to give an additional layer of polish before I call it the official release build.


Changelog:

- 12 New story scenes

- New location: cinema!

- 9 New repeatable scenes

- 3 New secret images

- Ability to toggle on/off naming saves (Default is off, can be found on the preferences menu)

- Remade Claire's footjob repeatable scene with new animations.

- Added the final scene! 

- Fixed a whole bunch of typos!

notes.title: V0.23 Release - The Achievement Update!
notes.content:
V0.23 is here for everyone! This is a bit of a different update from usual as for the first time since the game was created, I'm encouraging people to start a clean save!

Why am I encouraging this? Because of achievements! A lot of achievements are granted as you progress through the game, so continuing an old save means you will be unable to get these achievements.

That said, if you're not interested in achievements, old saves should work fine, but save files have moved!

If you want to continue an old save, you'll have to go to the old save location C:\Users\%userprofile%\AppData\Roaming\LunarsChosen-1549893754 and move them to the new one which should be C:\Users\%userprofile%\AppData\Roaming\RenPy\PTGames\Lunars Chosen. Similar changes should be made to MAC and android save locations.

Of course, if you are starting a new save, you don't need to worry about that as the game will automatically save and load in the new location!

Additionally, there's also some revamped renders and animations in the early game too! For those of you that don't want to find all the secret images again or would like a bump start on money, there are cheat codes available for supporters over on Patreon.

Changelog:

- 12 New story scenes

- 1 New mind read scene in the club

- 2 new photoshoots

- 51 New achievements

- 5 New secret images

- Fixed a whole load of unreturned calls, which should greatly reduce error log sizes.

- Improved a load of old code

- Updated two old scenes with improved renders and new animations!

It's finally here, just in time for Christmas. Honestly with the postal strikes happening, I wondered if it was going to be delivered on time, but I'm glad it made it!

V0.22 is now live for you all to play! It contains a whole bunch of new content, ranging from new story to a bunch of new sexy outfits for Emily to wear. There's also new characters to meet and have fun with, a bunch of new repeatable scenes, a new photoshoot and before I forget, two Halloween scenes. I know, I know, it's way past Halloween, but it was Halloween when I made them!

I've also added a whole load of old scenes to the replay system, so you can go back and view them at your leisure, or pleasure as it may be. There's been a few other fixes and changes too, such as a new opacity slider for those of you that want a more transparent text box and literally hundreds of typos and grammatical errors have been fixed!

notes.title: V0.21 Release!
notes.content:
V0.21 is now here! This update contains a whole bunch of new early game scenes with whole new characters (don't worry, you don't need a new save to see them) as well as new story content for all the main characters. There's also new repeatable events, even animated ones! 

One of the most common complaints I get is about the lack of things to do in the early game, so I put it to a poll on Patreon and they decided that this update should focus on adding in some early game events. So now there are six new characters to meet and interact with. They won't have any major story like the main characters, but give you something to do in the early game between main story events. I plan on adding a couple more in each update going forward to really flesh out the world of the game.

- Removed 2 early game grind scenes from Amy's story to speed it up.

- Removed Katie affection requirements to speed up her early story.

- 9 New early game scenes

- 11 New Story scenes

- 1 New non animated repeatable scene

notes.title: V0.20 Steam Release!
notes.content:
It's finally here, V0.20 is now ready for public release. This update focuses on Meg as she won the poll, so we get to see more of her story around her mothers. There's a few new repeatable scenes this update, with more ways to pass the time too. Of course, as always there's new story for every character, although Serena only got one scene of her own as she features heavily in Meg's story.

I also added a whole new section to the MC's PC; character bios! This page will tell you who each character is, their affiliation to you and their story so far. So for those of you that haven't played in a while, it's a perfect way to remind yourself who is who! Their pictures also change depending on where you are in the story with them!

There's loads of other content too, such as more secret images, a commissioned photoshoot and more! Enjoy!

- 2 New toys added to the store

- 4 New scenes to pass the time in MC's room

- A new character profile page on the PC, allowing you to recap their stories and who they are.

- 1 New photoshoot

notes.title: Lunar's Chosen V0.18 Beta #3 is now live on Patreon!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

As I'm sure some of you are aware, this game is actually funded through support on Patreon and Subscribestar! One of the rewards offered there is access to Beta updates. These are WIP updates of the newest version of the game, containing loads of new content and story!

Supporters also get a bunch of other benefits such as:
- Access to preview images
- Monthly 4K wallpapers
- Custom Renders
- Access to polls about upcoming content
- Access to private Discord channels
- And more!

The latest beta of V0.18 has just gone live. If anyone is interested and wants to support the game, the downloads can be found here:

Patreon

Subscribestar


If you're not interested or can't afford to support, don't worry. All the content in the beta's will be coming to the public release eventually. If you do decide to support, thank you! It's because of the support that this can continue to be made, I really couldn't have made it without you awesome people!
